entities.name: US Mass Incarceration Crisis
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The US has 2 million prisoners — 25% of the world's incarcerated population despite being 4% of global population. The prison population grew 500% between 1972 and 2009, driven by the "War on Drugs" and mandatory minimums. Black Americans are incarcerated at 5x the rate of white Americans. Private prisons profit from imprisonment.
